wars.caption: Thutmose I's campaign against Kerma: Egyptian victory; the kingdom of Kerma was defeated (c.1500 BCE, shortly before)
Meroitic forces attacked the Thebaid, taking Syene, Elephantine and Philae, after part of the Roman garrison left with Aelius Gallus for Arabia (SFDAS pp.243–244, quoting Strabo).
Ezana of Aksum's campaign against the Kushites and Noba: Ezana's Ge'ez inscription DAE 11 records his war against the Noba and the Kasu at the Nile–Atbara confluence (SFDAS pp.325–326).
